problem_type: Benchmark pointer inputs must reach the intended card rather than an overlapping action
symptom: Linux M/click-select exceeds 53ms at 59.4ms while selecting only 3 of 6 mounted nodes and opening the timeline.
direct_cause: The benchmark clicks raw box-relative coordinates without checking the topmost element. CI evidence contains timeline clip thumbnails and a stage shortened from 876 to 688 pixels; the measured workload includes an unintended timeline edit.
class_root: Two selection workload constructors bypass the existing canvas hit owner, so layout and overlay changes silently change the measured action.
affected_population: click-select and multi-node-drag on any viewport or overlay layout
internal_only_reason: The repository already owns hit testing in tests/ux/_canvasHit.mjs:234. No third-party API change or performance budget recalibration is needed.
invariants: Select exactly the same requested cards by real mouse input, using a verified hit point for each card.
Fail when a requested card has no selectable point; never silently click another action.
All existing timing budgets and scenario verdict assertions remain unchanged.
generality_proof: Both selection input paths use the same current DOM hit owner already used by ordinary canvas walkthroughs; they recheck per click as overlays change.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Existing shared DOM hit owner rejects foreign overlays and interactive card controls.
Reject direct arithmetic mouse.click coordinates in all scanned canvas performance runners.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Former raw box.x + width * 0.45 / box.y + 14 site detected by the new gate before migration.
Independent pick.box arithmetic site also fails the new gate; selection and primary drag reuse live hit testing.

recurrence.reason: Any new overlay or viewport clipping can change the recipient of an unchecked screen coordinate.
same_class_scan: rg mouse.click in benchmark and canvas-perf found both raw box-relative sites and the already-safe blank.x/blank.y caller.
CI main and B5 sample actionDetails compared: 6/6 versus 3/6 selected; timeline media only in B5; zoom remains 1 in both.
rg findNodeHitPoint in tests/ux found existing frame and three-gesture walkthroughs using the shared owner.

prevention.invariant: Canvas performance mouse.click calls may not compute raw coordinate arithmetic inline.
prevention.failure_mode: Gate exits nonzero for each direct raw coordinate click; runtime hit lookup fails closed when the intended card is not hittable.
prevention.strategy: Reuse existing hit testing at both measured selection inputs and extend the existing gesture gate; no second geometry implementation.

legacy_paths.rationale: Both raw click sites are replaced; no raw-coordinate fallback is retained.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Use existing Playwright/DOM calls and existing repository hit helper; dependencies unchanged.

migration: No production or persisted schema change; performance budgets remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
residual_risks: The static rule covers direct arithmetic clicks, not arbitrary data flow through precomputed variables.
Local macOS metrics do not replace the Linux job; report the pushed revision CI separately.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Shared hit owner determines gesture recipient; gate fixtures enforce adoption at benchmark call sites.
